name: UEM Sunrise Berhad
summary: UEM Sunrise Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the township and property development business in Malaysia, Australia, Singapore, and South Africa. It operates in three segments: Property Development, Property Investment and Hotel Operation, and Others. The company develops and sells residential and commercial properties. It also engages in the land trading, property investment, project procurement and management, investment holding, land leasing, assets and facilities management, and harvesting operations, as well as landowning business.
